commercial_terms.metering_note: Install-time and call-time trust checks can be metered by Tollbooth at fractions of a cent per check. See metering hooks in the reference implementation.
commercial_terms.payment: 50% upfront, balance on manifest issuance. Continuous billed monthly, cancel anytime.

description: Adversarial behavioral verification of agent skills / MCP servers. Output is an Ed25519-signed Trust Manifest (schema v1.0) bound to the exact code hash tested. Scanners guess, we prove.
request_flow: QUOTE: POST /v1/quote with target + tier, receive fixed-fee quote
REQUEST: POST /v1/request with the quote id, receive job id + status URL
VERIFY: when the job is complete, fetch the manifest, verify the Ed25519 signature offline against the published key, and confirm subject.code_hash matches your pinned artifact

includes: Automated adversarial battery + human review of failures
Core invariant classes (authorization, data_flow, description_fidelity, fail_closed)
tiers.name: Skill Sprint
tiers.sla_description: Manifest issued within 48 hours of payment confirmation.

includes: Full adversarial battery: confused-deputy scenarios, exfiltration via error paths, replay attacks, tool-description rug-pull simulation
tiers.name: Skill Standard
tiers.sla_description: Manifest issued within 5 days of payment confirmation.

tiers.name: Skill Rush
tiers.sla_description: Manifest issued within 24 hours of payment confirmation. Same battery as Standard.

includes: Automatic re-verification on every version bump
Cancel anytime; badge lapses 7 days after cancellation or on first unverified version
tiers.name: Skill Continuous
tiers.sla_description: Re-verification on every version bump, manifest re-issued within 5 days of the bump. Badge lapses if a version ships unverified; revocation on critical finding.

verification_method.summary: Bounded stateful adversarial execution of the live skill against declared invariants (authorization, data_flow, financial, description_fidelity, replay, fail_closed). No manifest is issued for a skill that was never executed: the harness fails on vacuity (minimum successful operations + minimum landed adversarial cases, attested in the manifest).
